title: Tip & Bill Splitter
steps: HTML: bill amount, tip % (select), people count (input) aur 'Calculate' button banao.
JS: elements select karo: const bill = document.querySelector('#bill') waghera.
Function calc() likho: tip = bill * pct / 100; total = bill + tip; perPerson = total / people.
Input validation: bill <= 0 ya people < 1 par error message dikhao.
Result ko toFixed(2) se format karo aur page par dikhao (textContent).
Button click aur Enter key dono par calc() chalao.
Bonus: Intl.NumberFormat se currency format (INR).
Test: bill 1000, tip 10%, 4 log => per person 275.

title: Todo App with localStorage
steps: HTML: input, Add button, ul#list, filter buttons (All/Active/Done).
State: let todos = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('todos') || '[]') ; har todo {id, text, done}.
render() function likho: list clear karo aur todos se li banao (textContent use karo, innerHTML nahi).
Add: form submit par trim() check, todos.push({id: Date.now(), text, done:false}), save(), render().
Event delegation: ul par ek click listener; e.target.closest('li') se id nikalo; toggle/delete handle karo.
save() = localStorage.setItem('todos', JSON.stringify(todos)); har change ke baad call karo.
Filters: currentFilter variable se todos.filter() karke render karo.
Bonus: edit on double-click, 'clear completed', items left counter.

title: Digital Clock + Stopwatch + Countdown
steps: Clock: setInterval(() => el.textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString(), 1000).
Stopwatch state: running, startTime, elapsed.
Start: startTime = Date.now() - elapsed; interval chalao (100ms).
Pause: clearInterval aur elapsed update; Reset: sab zero.
format(ms) function: mm:ss.t padStart(2,'0') se.
Countdown: target date input se remaining = target - Date.now(); 0 par alert/sound.
Tip: Date.now() se time nikalo (interval ticks par bharosa mat karo).

title: Quiz App
steps: Data: const questions = [{q, options:[..], answer: index}, ...] (10 sawal).
State: current = 0, score = 0, answered = false.
showQuestion(): current question aur options buttons render karo.
Option click: correct/wrong highlight, score++ agar sahi, buttons disable.
Next button: current++; agar last ho to result screen dikhao.
Result: score, percentage aur message; Restart button.
Bonus: timer per question, shuffle questions (Fisher-Yates), high score localStorage mein.

title: Calculator
steps: HTML grid: digits, operators, '=', 'C', '.', display div.
State: current, previous, operator.
Digit click: current string mein append (do decimals roko).
Operator click: agar previous aur current ho to pehle compute(), fir operator set karo.
compute(a, b, op): switch(op); division by zero par 'Error'.
Equals: compute karke display; C: reset.
Keyboard support: keydown se digits/operators map karo.
Never use eval() - safe compute function use karo.

title: Random User / Weather App with fetch
steps: API choose karo (free, key-less): https://randomuser.me/api/ ya https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=23.35&longitude=85.33&current_weather=true (Ranchi).
HTML: button/search input, card container, loading aur error elements.

async function load(): loading dikhao; try { const r = await fetch(url); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); const data = await r.json(); render(data); } catch(e) { showError } finally { hide loading }.
render(data): fields nikalo (destructuring) aur card banao.
Browser Network tab mein request/response inspect karo.
AbortController se timeout (5s) lagao.
Bonus: last result localStorage mein cache karo; city dropdown.

title: Expense Tracker
steps: Form: description, amount, type (income/expense), category, date.
Data: expenses array [{id, desc, amount, type, category, date}] + localStorage.
Add/delete entries; validation (amount > 0, desc required).
Summary: income, expense, balance = reduce se.
Category totals: groupBy reduce; chart ke liye table ya <canvas>/CSS bars.
Filters: month, category; sort: date/amount.
Currency format: Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN', {style:'currency', currency:'INR'}).
Bonus: CSV export (Blob + a[download]).

title: Tic-Tac-Toe with Win Detection
steps: Board = Array(9).fill(null); turn = 'X'.
HTML/CSS grid 3x3 cells with data-index.
Click: agar cell khali aur game on ho to board[i] = turn; render.
checkWinner(): WIN.find(([a,b,c]) => board[a] && board[a] === board[b] && board[a] === board[c]).
Draw: board.every(Boolean) and no winner; Restart button.
Bonus: simple computer opponent (random, fir minimax).

title: Image Slider / Carousel
steps: Slides ko flex container mein rakho; overflow hidden.
index state; goTo(i) = container.style.transform = `translateX(${-i*100}%)`.
Prev/Next buttons with wrap-around: (i + n) % n.
Dots navigation; active dot class.
Autoplay setInterval; hover/focus par pause; clearInterval.
Keyboard arrows aur touch swipe (touchstart/touchend).
Accessibility: aria-label buttons par, alt text images par.

title: Password Generator + Strength Meter
steps: Options: length slider, uppercase/lowercase/numbers/symbols checkboxes.
Character pools strings mein rakho; selected pools merge karo.
Generate: crypto.getRandomValues se secure random index.
Har selected type ka kam se kam ek character guarantee karo.
Strength: length + variety ke hisaab se Weak/Medium/Strong (regex tests).
Copy button: navigator.clipboard.writeText + 'Copied!' feedback.
Note: Math.random() security ke liye nahi hota.

title: Movie/Book Search with Debounce
steps: Free API chuno (jaise Open Library: https://openlibrary.org/search.json?q=harry+potter).
Search input par debounce(300ms) lagao.
Query URL URLSearchParams se banao; encodeURIComponent dhyan se.
AbortController se purana request cancel karo (race condition rokne ke liye).
Results cards render; empty state aur error state dikhao.
Pagination ya 'Load more' (page param).
Favorites list localStorage mein.
Bonus: IntersectionObserver se infinite scroll.

title: REST API with Node + Express
steps: mkdir api && cd api && npm init -y && npm i express
package.json mein 'type': 'module' set karo.
server.js: const app = express(); app.use(express.json());
In-memory data: let todos = []; GET /todos, GET /todos/:id.
POST /todos: body validate karo (text required) -> 201 + created object; invalid par 400.
PUT/PATCH /todos/:id aur DELETE /todos/:id; missing id par 404.
Error middleware aur logging middleware (method, url, time).
Test: curl ya Postman/Thunder Client; bonus: data JSON file mein persist (fs.promises).
